summary.text: Calvin Beaulier is a Republican state representative from Grafton District 1 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as an attorney and small business owner who lives in Littleton.

paragraphs.text: Calvin Beaulier was born in Houston, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from American University in 2008 and a law degree from the Louisiana State University School of Law in 2014.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an attorney, small business owner and real estate broker, and says he has served as an alternate on the Littleton Planning Board.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up with parents who worked in a series of small family businesses and that he and his wife returned to her native New Hampshire to raise their family after he finished law school.
Beaulier assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Grafton 1, a three-seat district.
